entry.title: Agent Helidon: License to Scale
entry.summary: While AI agents are rapidly advancing, the performance and scalability of the agents and their underlying services have received too little attention. This session showcases Helidon powering scalable services via Virtual Thread–based MCP servers and high-performance agents through its compile-time integration with LangChain4j.

entry.title: The Limitations of Running a Workload Generator In the Same JVM as the System-Under-Test
entry.summary: When you evaluate a system with a garbage collector and want to understand its tail latency, you often see SPECjbb2015 or DaCapo used. While both offer corrective measures for coordinated omission, only SPECjbb2015 can run the workload generator and backend server in the same JVM, as well as separate them into different JVMs. This post is a deep dive that uses SPECjbb2015's flexibility to explore and highlight the risks of running the workload generator in the same JVM as the backend.
